title: Machine learning in healthcare: review, opportunities and challenges
venue: Machine Learning and the Internet of Medical Things in Healthcare
abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive review of machine learning in healthcare, outlining the opportunities and challenges in its application. It delves into various aspects of how ML can transform healthcare practices.

title: Federated machine learning in healthcare: A systematic review on clinical applications and technical architecture
abstract: This systematic review explores federated machine learning in healthcare, focusing on its clinical applications and technical architecture. It highlights how this approach can address data privacy concerns in collaborative medical research.

title: Privacy‐preserving data mining and machine learning in healthcare: Applications, challenges, and solutions
abstract: This paper discusses privacy and security challenges in data mining and machine learning applications within medical diagnostic systems. It proposes solutions to address the sensitive nature of healthcare data, emphasizing the importance of privacy-preserving techniques.

title: AI and Machine Learning in Healthcare - Applications, Challenges and Ethics
abstract: This research aims to discuss the applications of AI and machine learning in healthcare, along with the associated implementation challenges and ethical considerations. It also touches upon the regulatory landscape surrounding the widespread adoption of AI in healthcare.

title: Privacy-preserving machine learning for healthcare: open challenges and future perspectives
abstract: This paper examines the open challenges and future perspectives of privacy-preserving machine learning in healthcare. It emphasizes the critical need for privacy considerations throughout the entire ML pipeline due to the sensitive nature of medical data.

title: Beyond Volume: The Impact of Complex Healthcare Data on the Machine Learning Pipeline
abstract: This paper explores the impact of complex healthcare data on the machine learning pipeline, highlighting the challenges and opportunities presented by the digital transformation of healthcare. It discusses data ranging from electronic health records to digitized imaging.

title: Using machine learning for healthcare challenges and opportunities
abstract: This article discusses the challenges and opportunities of using machine learning in healthcare. It highlights the growing attention on ML applications to improve healthcare and how supervised learning can be used for this purpose.

title: The impact of artificial intelligence in medicine on the future role of the physician
abstract: This research investigates the potential uses of AI in medicine and considers its impact on the future role of physicians. It explores whether AI might replace or supplement the work of medical professionals.

title: Artificial intelligence (AI) in medicine, current applications and future role with special emphasis on its potential and promise in pathology: present and future impact
abstract: This paper discusses the current applications and future role of artificial intelligence in medicine, with a particular focus on its potential in pathology. It highlights the rapid expansion of AI's role in the medical field.

venue: UNIVERSITY OF ALABAMA AT BIRMINGHAM (NIH Project)
abstract: This NIH-funded project investigates the efficacy of a vaccine in preventing the progression of invasive breast cancer. It explores how immunotherapy against specific antigens can offer a new approach to breast cancer prevention.

title: Privacy-preserving machine learning for healthcare: open challenges and future perspectives
abstract: This paper discusses the critical aspect of privacy in machine learning for healthcare, outlining open challenges and future perspectives. It emphasizes that due to the sensitive nature of medical data, privacy must be considered throughout the entire ML pipeline, from model training to deployment.

title: Beyond Volume: The Impact of Complex Healthcare Data on the Machine Learning Pipeline
abstract: This paper explores the impact of complex healthcare data on the machine learning pipeline, moving beyond simply data volume. It highlights how the transition to digital healthcare, including electronic health records and digitized imaging, presents unique challenges and opportunities for ML.

title: Ethical machine learning in healthcare
abstract: This review focuses on establishing an ethical pipeline for machine learning model development in healthcare. It addresses various ethical considerations at each stage, with a particular emphasis on social justice implications in the context of healthcare AI.

title: Identifying ethical considerations for machine learning healthcare applications
abstract: This paper identifies key ethical considerations pertinent to machine learning healthcare applications (ML-HCAs). It examines how these applications, although promising for healthcare delivery, raise a number of ethical challenges that need careful navigation.

abstract: Machine learning (ML) is a type of artificial intelligence that assists computers in the acquisition of knowledge through data analysis, thus creating machines that can complete tasks otherwise requiring human intelligence. Among its various applications, it has proven groundbreaking in healthcare and medical research.

venue: International Journal of Scientific Research in Computer Science Engineering and Information Technology
abstract: This article explores the transformative potential of artificial intelligence (AI) in mobile health (mHealth) applications for chronic disease management. The article examines how AI-powered mHealth apps are revolutionizing healthcare delivery through personalized treatment plans, real-time monitoring, and predictive analytics.

title: A Literature Survey on AI Health Care System
venue: International Journal of Advanced Research in Science, Communication and Technology
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare systems has witnessed remarkable progress in recent years, revolutionizing the landscape of patient care, diagnostics, and medical research. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of the diverse applications, challenges, and benefits of AI in healthcare.

title: Federated learning, ethics, and the double black box problem in medical AI
abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a machine learning approach that allows multiple devices or institutions to collaboratively train a model without sharing their local data with a third-party. FL is considered a promising way to address patient privacy concerns in medical artificial intelligence. The ethical implications of FL are discussed.

title: Federated Learning in Healthcare: A Path Towards Decentralized and Secure Medical Insights
venue: INTERANTIONAL JOURNAL OF SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH IN ENGINEERING AND MANAGEMENT
abstract: The rise of artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare has created opportunities for advanced predictive models and personalized treatments, yet the sensitive nature of medical data presents significant challenges in terms of privacy, security, and regulatory compliance. Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a promising solution.
